name: Live browser and agent log run side by side
looks: A real browser window sits beside a dark log panel. As the log types on a numbered step ('observe', 'click a link', 'scroll'), the browser's matching element glows and the page itself navigates and scrolls to match, until a small 'goal reached' badge pops over the clicked button and the log's last line confirms it is done.
build: terminal-type-on drives the log's step-by-step reveal; provenance-glow-stroke marks whichever element the current step targets, moving from element to element in lockstep with the log, never more than one glowing at once; the badge pops in with a spring on the exact frame the glow lands on the target button.
sound: A key tick per log line, a soft chime each time the glow moves to a new element, and a confirm hit on the goal-reached badge.
prompt: Prove an agent's actions are real, not simulated: run a live interface beside a log of its steps, a glowing marker moving from element to element in the interface exactly as the matching step appears in the log, finishing on a badge that confirms the goal was reached.
